# Your contact form, your server, no per-submission fee.

> Point any HTML form at your own server: spam scoring with visible reasons, an inbox, CSV export and email or Slack notifications. Open source, MIT, no per-submission fee. Test the spam filter in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
